name: After § 17
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for actions to address the continued oppression and fake elections in Belarus
part_text: 17a. Condemns the violation of the right to freedom of association by the regime; calls on all opposition forces to commit to respecting the ILO conventions, in particular Conventions Nos. 87 and 98, and article 33 of the ILO Constitution;
